## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger and before/after behavior. Separate observed facts, computed
values and inference. State whether source, policy, score or UI changed.

## Evidence and validation

- [ ] Relevant tests ran; exact commands/results and failed checks are included.
- [ ] A statistical change has an independent expected result or counterexample.
- [ ] Real-data changes identify source version, evidence/rights and coverage gaps.
- [ ] Public outputs contain institution aggregates without personal trajectories.
- [ ] UI changes have fresh desktop/mobile images and keyboard/fallback checks.
- [ ] Release changes verify the selected manifest and build provenance.
- [ ] Data/process work preserves checkpoints, idempotence and resource limits.

## Risk, recovery and review

State rollback, residual risks, reviewer expertise and any changes to coverage,
denominator, graph direction, evidence confidence or attribution. Internal reviews
are not independent third-party approval. Presence in code or a pass on another
revision cannot substitute for executed verification.
